segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּימֵרַבִּי יִצְחָק חֲתַן הַמַּגִּיד מִטִּירָהאוִויצֶע שֶׁאָמַר שֶׁשָּׁמַע מִפִּיו  הַקָּדוֹשׁ  שֶׁאָמַר  שֶׁבַּדֶּרֶךְ צְרִיכִין לִזָּהֵר בִּטְבִילַת מִקְוֶה, כִּי מִקְוֶה מְסֻגָּל לְהִנָּצֵל מֵרוֹצְחִים:
segments.en: (36.) He said: "Through telling stories of tzaddikim and greatening and extolling them — through this, harsh judgment is sweetened and kindness is drawn down." And this is [Psalms 18]: "He magnifies the salvations of His King" — "who are kings? The Rabbis" [Gittin 62a]. That is: one who tells and magnifies the wonders and salvations of the tzaddikim who are called kings — through this "He does kindness to His anointed" — meaning Hashem Yisburach does kindness to one who speaks and tells of this.
